name: Exec CoS Digest
tagline: Opens your weekday with a calendar rundown and preps tomorrow's outside meetings
description: Aimed at anyone whose Monday-to-Friday is really a queue of appointments. Early each morning it lays the day's schedule out in a single read, and the evening before it gathers background on whoever you are meeting from outside the company. Everything lands as a draft; nothing irreversible happens without your say-so.
author: Monty
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
